key.name: pastepop-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut that opens and closes the clipboard history
key.description: When it is one of GNOME’s shortcuts for the notification list, such as Super+V, the notification list keeps only its other shortcuts while the extension is on. Nothing is written to GNOME’s settings.

key.name: history-size
key.summary: Number of items to keep, not counting pins

key.name: keep-unpinned
key.summary: How long unpinned items are kept
key.description: “restart” keeps them until the computer restarts, as on Windows.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: When off, choosing an item only copies it.

key.name: show-symbols
key.summary: Show the emoji, symbol and kaomoji tabs

key.name: recent-symbols
key.summary: Recently inserted emoji and symbols, newest first

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: App IDs whose copies are never recorded

key.name: terminal-apps
key.summary: App IDs that paste with Ctrl+Shift+V

key.name: onboarded
key.summary: Whether the first-run notification was shown
